name: App Clips and Instant Apps
plain: App Clips run a small part of an app without installing; Google shut Instant Apps down in December 2025.
meaning: A lightweight launch from a link, QR or NFC tag, before any install. App Clips are limited to 15 MB (50 MB for digital only launches) and lose most background and sensor access.

android.store_policy: Google Play shut down Instant Apps in December 2025
android.note: Instant Apps no longer available; use web links or Play 'try now' streaming

ios.permission: Associated Domains (appclips: entitlement); ephemeral notifications permission via NSAppClipRequestEphemeralUserNotification
ios.prompt_ui: Invocation card from link, QR, NFC, Maps or Safari banner
ios.persistence: Removed after a period of disuse; data migrates to the full app on install via shared app group
ios.revocation: Deleted by the system or the user
ios.store_policy: App Review 5.1.1 and App Clip guidelines
ios.api_surface: App Clip target, NSUserActivity, appClip invocation URL
ios.note: Size 15 MB (iOS 16+) or 50 MB digital only (iOS 17+); no background URLSession, no background modes; ephemeral notifications for about 8 hours (unverified)

limits.headline: Can run a tiny part of an app from a link or tag, iPhone only
limits.user_action: You scan a QR code, tap an NFC tag, or tap a link or banner
can: Run a small part of an app without installing it (iPhone)
Start from a QR code, NFC tag, Maps card or Safari banner
Send you notifications for about 8 hours after launch
cannot: Go past 15 MB, or 50 MB for digital only launches
Keep running tasks in the background
Work on Android, since Instant Apps were shut down in December 2025
Use the full set of sensors and permissions of the whole app
limits.reach_label: Only while you use the clip
limits.differs: iPhone has App Clips. Android Instant Apps are discontinued; use web links instead.

story.what_it_is: A tiny slice of an app that opens instantly from a tap, scan or link, with no install.

marketing.name: App Clips
marketing.pitch: A small part of an app that is fast and easy to open, right when you need it.

marketing.name: Google Play Instant
marketing.pitch: Try an app or game without installing it. Google ended Instant Apps in late 2025.

story.for_you: You scan a code at a scooter, parking meter or coffee shop and a small card slides up. You pay or order in seconds and never visit the App Store.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to cut the steps between wanting something and doing it. A full install loses most people, so a small taste that offers the full app afterward turns more visitors into users.

use_cases.example: You scan a QR code on an e-scooter and a card lets you unlock and ride in seconds.
You tap an NFC sticker at a coffee shop and order and pay from a card with Apple Pay.
A parking meter sign gives you a code. You scan it and pay for time without making an account.
A playable demo opens from a link in a message so you can try a level before you install.
A store tag opens a card that shows the size and color options and checks out with Apple Pay.
An ad for a game opens a short taste, and the ad network counts how many people then install the full app.

risks: Small data gets sent before install
story.android_note: Google shut down Instant Apps in December 2025, so on Android this is now mostly web based.
story.ios_note: iOS App Clips are limited to 15 MB (50 MB for digital only launches) and delete after a time.
